topic: Analytics model updates and data review
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on reviewing updated analytics models and data presented on the staging environment. Initial concerns were raised regarding a significant increase in total traffic when comparing raw versus new model data, particularly for master facilities.

It was noted that the new calculation method counts sessions from one device across different screens within the master facility, leading to higher overall figures. For CityMedia, specific adjustments were made to ensure session calculations matched those used by Fields.

Multiple comparisons were made (e.g., week-over-week) showing traffic increases of 33-36% using the model data. The final update confirmed that fixed session calculations for the CityMedia master facility had been applied, aligning its metrics with those used for Fields.
decisions: The new analytics models are being tested on staging environments.
CityMedia's master facility session calculation was updated to match the methodology used by Fields.
action_items: Review of staging-analytics.com is required for different clients without admin rights (assigned to Anastasiya Pyatnitsa).
Double check MC data for CityMedia and confirm suitability based on model comparison.
